run_probe_report_checker: run the probe report checker script with two JSON report files and an expected outcome flag
compare_cma_reports: compare two CMA probe JSON reports to validate syscall success and autodetection viability
validate_syscall_success: validate that both probe reports have matching syscall success status against expected outcome
check_cma_autodetection: check whether CMA autodetection correctly predicted syscall behavior by comparing viability and device descriptors
review_probe_report_checker: review the probe report checker script that validates CMA channel probe reports for TensorPipe tests
